title: Article 91 — Power of the Deputy Chairman or other person to perform the duties of the office of, or to act as, Chairman

content.overview: Article 91 provides for performance of the duties of the office of Chairman of the Council of States when the office is vacant or the Vice-President is acting as President or is absent: the Deputy Chairman, or if the office of Deputy Chairman is also vacant such member as the Council may determine, performs the duties; during absence of the Chairman from a sitting, the Deputy Chairman or such person as may be determined by the rules of procedure of the Council, or by the Council, acts as Chairman.
content.glance: When Chairman’s office vacant / VP acting as President / Chairman absent: Deputy Chairman (or Council’s choice) performs duties or acts as Chairman.
content.study:
Article 91 covers vacancy and absence arrangements for the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Vice-President). The Deputy Chairman is the primary substitute; the Council may determine another member if needed. Rules of procedure also govern acting arrangements during a sitting.

Examination: vacancy vs absence; Deputy Chairman as default; Council/rules residual power.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
Vacancy or VP acting as President: Deputy Chairman (or Council-determined member) performs duties of Chairman.
Absence during sitting: Deputy Chairman or person under rules/Council acts as Chairman.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who acts when the office of Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is vacant?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 91, when the office of Chairman is vacant or the Vice-President is acting as President, the Deputy Chairman of the Council of States, or if that office is also vacant such member of the Council as the Council may determine, performs the duties of the office of Chairman.

examTips: Deputy Chairman is the default substitute for RS Chairman.

keyTakeaways: Art 91: Deputy Chairman acts when Chairman vacant/absent.
